nodes.summary: Let $R$ and $S$ be commutative semirings with $S$ an $R$-algebra, and let $f$ be a multivariate polynomial over $R$ in variables indexed by a type $\sigma$. Then $f$ has a solution in $S$ if there is a vector $x \in S^\sigma$ whose components generate the unit ideal of $S$ and such that $f(x) = 0$, where $f$ is evaluated at $x$ through the algebra map $R \to S$.

nodes.summary: For a real number $A$, $\mathbb{V}_{d,n}(A)$ is the set of degree-$d$ hypersurfaces $V \in \mathbb{V}_{d,n}$ in $\mathbb{P}^n$ whose height is at most $A$, where the height of $V$ is the height of the chosen nonzero homogeneous polynomial of degree $d$ that represents $V$.

nodes.summary: Let $f$ be a multivariate polynomial with rational coefficients. Multiply the coefficients of $f$ by the least common multiple of their denominators and divide the resulting integers by their greatest common divisor; this gives the primitive integer coefficient vector $(a_m)_m$ of $f$, indexed by the monomials $m$ in the support of $f$. nodes.summary: $\mathbb{V}^{\mathrm{loc}}_{d,n}$ is the set of degree-$d$ hypersurfaces $V \in \mathbb{V}_{d,n}$ in $\mathbb{P}^n$ that are everywhere locally soluble, that is, with $V(\mathbb{A}_\mathbb{Q}) \ne \emptyset$: the chosen homogeneous polynomial representing $V$ has a solution in the adele ring $\mathbb{A}_\mathbb{Q}$, namely a zero given by $n + 1$ adeles that generate the unit ideal of $\mathbb{A}_\mathbb{Q}$.
nodes.title: Everywhere locally soluble hypersurfaces

nodes.summary: Let $d$ and $n$ be natural numbers with $d \ge 2$, $n \ge d$ and $(d, n) \ne (3, 3)$. Then the proportion $\rho_{d,n}(A)$ of degree-$d$ hypersurfaces in $\mathbb{P}^n$ of height at most $A$ that have a rational point tends to the local density $\rho^{\mathrm{loc}}_{d,n}$ as the real number $A$ tends to $\infty$.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
